SDN.note: Document is about a criminal law amendment; says nothing on IT standards.

facts.fact: Al Jazeera Net reports that the General Union of Sudanese Journalists and the Emergency Lawyers group criticised a temporary constitutional decree amending Article 51/A of the 1991 Criminal Act to cover electronic publishing, the union saying the press was not consulted.

SDN.note: The amendment widens an offence to electronic publishing, but no one is reported charged under it.
Says nothing on a shared African digital law.
